text:
If your weekend calls for sun before the pattern flips, today's the day to cash it in. Burlington starts crisp, near 54 this morning, but clears out into a genuinely sunny sky with a high right around 81 and winds staying light, out of the south at just 2 to 8 mph. Air quality's good, UV is moderate-high near 6.5 so don't skip the sunscreen, and the lake is calm and inviting, water still 72, waves a foot or less through the afternoon before building slightly tonight.

Sunday's the flip side. A pair of systems moves in and showers turn likely from mid-morning on, with thunder possible by afternoon, and the high backs off into the upper 70s to near 80. The Euro's noticeably wetter and cooler than the American model here, so if you've got Sunday plans, lean toward expecting rain rather than hoping it stays dry. Get your lake time and outdoor plans in today. Good waterfront window through this evening, and I'd have Sunday afternoon plans indoors or flexible by late morning.
